macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

items.title: U.S. stocks rebound as investors weigh oil, yields and Fed policy
items.summary: The Nasdaq Composite, S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average rose modestly in early Friday trading as technology shares recovered. Elevated Treasury yields, oil prices near $104 per barrel and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s next move continued to pressure sentiment.

items.title: Treasury yields remain near multi-year highs ahead of CPI
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was reported around 5.24%, while investors awaited September consumer-price data and reassessed the likelihood of another Federal Reserve rate increase. Markets had reduced expectations for an October hike but continued to price substantial risk of a December increase.

items.title: Oil surge and semiconductor weakness weigh on Wall Street
items.summary: U.S. stocks ended lower Thursday as crude prices jumped amid Middle East shipping disruptions and reduced U.S. output, intensifying inflation and interest-rate concerns. Semiconductor shares underperformed after reports raised questions about OpenAI’s revenue outlook and potential technology-sector debt financing.

items.title: Delta Air Lines shares fall after earnings miss and weaker outlook
items.summary: Delta Air Lines declined after reporting disappointing earnings and reducing its annual profit outlook. The results highlighted investor concerns about airline costs and weaker operating performance.

items.title: TSMC reports record quarterly revenue on AI-chip demand
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing reported record third-quarter revenue of NT$1.49 trillion, driven by continued demand for artificial-intelligence chips.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ether fall amid ETF outflows
items.summary: Bitcoin traded near $82,357, down 1.1% over 24 hours, while Ether fell 3.4%; the broader crypto market declined about 2.1% to $2.87 trillion. Reports attributed pressure partly to nearly $1 billion in two-day crypto ETF outflows.[9][2]

items.title: Thailand finalizes crypto ETF framework
items.summary: Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission approved regulations for locally listed crypto ETFs, initially covering Bitcoin and Ether. The framework takes effect October 16, 2026.[2][3]

items.title: EU sets deadline for non-compliant stablecoins
items.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority said MiCA-authorized crypto firms must eliminate remaining exposure to non-compliant stablecoins by January 8, 2027, including related trading, custody, transfer and advisory services for EU clients.[3]

items.title: U.S. government-linked wallets transfer seized crypto to Coinbase Prime
items.summary: On-chain data indicated that U.S. government-linked wallets moved approximately $565.87 million in seized cryptocurrency to Coinbase Prime over several hours on October 7.[3]

items.title: Blast announces shutdown
items.summary: Ethereum Layer 2 network Blast announced that it is winding down after three years, giving users until October 26, 2026, to withdraw funds through its frontend.[1]

items.title: Abstract plans to wind down
items.summary: Blockchain project Abstract announced plans to close operations and instructed users to withdraw their funds on-chain by December 15, 2026.[1]

items.title: Securitize launches tokenized U.S. stocks
items.summary: Tokenization platform Securitize launched tokenized versions of U.S. stocks, expanding its blockchain-based securities offering.[6]

items.title: StarkWare CEO proposes quantum-resistant network transition
items.summary: StarkWare CEO Eli Ben-Sasson proposed transitioning Starknet from an Ethereum Layer 2 into an independent Layer 1 by 2027 to accelerate adoption of quantum-resistant cryptography.[9]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: NVIDIA publishes open 3D medical-imaging model
items.summary: NVIDIA published NV-Reason-CT, an open vision-language model designed to interpret chest and abdominal CT scans in 3D, reason through findings, and produce reports.

items.title: Anthropic launches critical-infrastructure cybersecurity initiative
items.summary: Anthropic announced an initiative to provide advanced AI models and engineering support to companies defending power grids, water utilities, and other critical infrastructure.

items.title: Anthropic commits $150 million to federal AI-for-science program
items.summary: Anthropic announced a three-year commitment to the Genesis Mission, making Claude available to more than 15 federal agencies involved in scientific research.

items.title: OpenAI releases hundreds of AI-generated mathematical papers
items.summary: OpenAI posted more than 700 AI-generated mathematics papers to GitHub, reporting that an unreleased model produced results across previously difficult problems.

items.title: Google introduces Gemini workplace agent
items.summary: Google Cloud introduced a general-purpose Gemini agent for work that can answer questions, complete tasks, create content, and write code, though customer availability details remain unclear.

items.title: Mistral Large 4 expands open-weight model competition
items.summary: Mistral Large 4 was highlighted as a major open-weight model release, with reporting describing a trillion-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts architecture and a focus on coding and cybersecurity.

items.title: OpenAI disrupts Russian and Iranian influence operations
items.summary: OpenAI said it shut down two influence operations that used ChatGPT to create fake journalist personas and promote covert political messaging.

items.title: Gallatin AI raises $50 million for defense applications
items.summary: Defense-focused AI startup Gallatin AI raised a $50 million Series A led by 8VC and Silent Ventures.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer released by Guildford studio
items.summary: A Guildford-based team has released Star Wars: Galactic Racer, a game developed since 2023 by roughly 75 people and focused on the Empire’s decline.

items.title: EU targets manipulative gaming monetization practices
items.summary: European consumer-protection authorities announced coordinated actions involving 10 video-game companies over alleged “dark patterns” that may put minors and people vulnerable to gaming addiction at risk.

items.title: Forza Horizon 6 PlayStation 5 version delayed to 2027
items.summary: The PlayStation 5 release of Forza Horizon 6 has reportedly been delayed to 2027 and is expected to launch alongside the game’s first premium expansion.

items.title: Six new games entered the US August top 10 by sales
items.summary: NBA 2K27 led paid-game revenue in the United States for August, while five other new releases—including Madden NFL 27, Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls, Star Wars Zero Company and Big Walk—also reached the top 10.

items.title: JetSynthesys and MIXI explore gaming partnership in India
items.summary: India’s JetSynthesys and Japan’s MIXI signed a memorandum of understanding covering potential collaboration in gaming, esports, digital entertainment, marketing and strategic investment.
